settings.ekit_heading_title: Nil T2 Filing for Toronto Corporations
settings.ekit_heading_extra_title:
A nil T2 is the corporate return a Toronto corporation files for a tax year in which it had no revenue, no expenses and no bank activity. The corporation still exists, so the return is still due. Incorporating and then going quiet does not end the obligation, and a year left unfiled stays open until the return is transmitted.

Nil T2 filing in Toronto covers the year end to end. The return is prepared and reviewed, you sign a T183CORP for each tax year, and the return is transmitted to the Canada Revenue Agency electronically. It is done online from start to finish, so there is nothing to print, mail or sign in person, wherever in the city your registered office sits.

settings.title: Nil T2 Filing Price in Toronto

settings.editor: $300.00 plus HST per tax year. The fee covers preparation, CPA review, the T183CORP for signature, and electronic transmission to the Canada Revenue Agency. Each unfiled tax year is a separate return at the same price.

settings.title: What the Fee Does Not Cover

settings.editor:
A nil T2 does not cover your Ontario annual return through the Ontario Business Registry. We tell you if you still owe one.

A federal Corporations Canada annual return costs $12.00 and is due within 60 days of your anniversary. It is a government fee and HST does not apply to it.

This service is for a corporation with no activity in the tax year. A corporation with investment income, rental income, or dividends paid or received is not nil. If your corporation is not nil, we move your file to gondaliyacpa.ca at $350.00 plus applicable sales tax per year and tell you before any further charge.
